content.short: Rarible is an Ethereum-based NFT platform for creating, selling and buying NFTs.
content.description: Rarible was founded in 2020 by Alex Salnikov. It is an Ethereum-based platform for creating, selling and buying NFTs. Users can acquire crypto assets on Rarible. Developers can use the Rarible Multichain Protocol to mint NFTs, create sell orders and bids, and purchase NFTs. The platform has 1.6 million users and $16 million in venture capital.
